echo "::error title=Not reverted::$sha broke the suite ($why), but reverting it changes nothing on main any more. Look at what main carries now."

node tools/grow.mjs retire "Taken back off the site: \"$subject\" ($sha) failed the browser suite on main ($why)." --by void-verify --ref "https://github.com/atomeam/void-loop/actions/runs/44244237062" && git add void-live-deploy/void.growth.json || true

git push origin main
node tools/suite-gate.mjs queue "$sha" "$why" || echo "::warning title=Fix job not filed::the revert is on main; the heal job was not queued"
gh workflow run deploy.yml --repo "atomeam/void-loop" --ref main -f after_merge=true
